entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k91; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: A flying monster appeared by the stairs and fired something like a beam. Will the stairs withstand it?
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k92; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: The stairs were destroyed, separating me from Yuki. I need to find a way down to reach ground level.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k93; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: I broke through a door and reached a maintenance walkway. There are no railings, so there's a risk of falling. I have to keep moving and meet up with Yuki again!
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k94; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
I managed to meet up with Yuki, but the stairs down
are still broken.
I'll look farther along the maintenance walkway for a ladder.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k95; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: A different giant creature appeared and burned down the flying monsters' nest. We almost got caught up in it, but at least the flying monsters shouldn't be able to chase us anymore.

entries.en: As we walked toward the bus stop, the two pursuers suddenly appeared with handguns. If we reach a busy street, they should hesitate to use them.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k100; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Head for a well-lit street while watching out for the pursuers' guns.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k101; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: A flying monster suddenly appeared, grabbed one of the pursuers, and flew away. We're safe from their guns, but...
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k102; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Reach the Bus Stop!
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k104; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: A huge flock of flying monsters suddenly appeared and began destroying the city. We need to head for the bus stop to get out of here.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k106; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Head for the bus stop farther along the avenue while watching out for flying monsters. Be careful of their shadows on the road.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k107; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Flying monsters landed on the road and caused traffic accidents, blocking the intersection. To escape them, we need to find a building we can pass through to reach the other side.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k108; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: We escaped the flying monsters and took shelter inside a building, but it seems dangerous here too. Is there a way to reach the other side of the intersection?
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k109; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: The bus stop is across the road. The flying monsters on the ground are closing in. We need to reach the bus as quickly as possible.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k110; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: We boarded the bus, but a flying monster overturned it, and Yuki was carried off by another flying monster...
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k111; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Lovers Parted by a Quarrel
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k113; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: The young man was carried off by a flying monster just as he stepped out of the truck bed.

entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k126; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: To escape the strange creatures we encountered underground, we followed a riot police officer's directions and drove away.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k127; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: We reached Sky Garden Bridge. We should be safe now that we've made it this far.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k128; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k130; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: As we reached Sky Garden Bridge, a black car rear-ended us. Sensing danger, we tried to get away.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k131; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: The black car is clearly trying to ram us on purpose. We need to get away.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k132; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Two men in black got out of the black car. They're coming toward us. We have to run...
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k133; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: A fierce-looking man appeared and stepped in to stop the two pursuers, whom he seemed to know. It looks like we're safe for now.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k134; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Giant Creatures in Flight
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k136; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
While the black car was chasing us, a giant flying creature appeared overhead.
We need to get off this bridge quickly. There's nowhere to hide.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k137; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Two giant creatures appeared overhead.
The dark-colored one's beams are destroying cars one after another. We have to escape, quickly!
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k138; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Even after we got out of the car, beams kept striking the bridge from time to time. We tried to get as far away as we could.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k139; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: We entered the restaurant on the north side of the bridge. Going to its first floor should let us reach the bridge's lower level.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k140; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: We somehow made it, but the lower level doesn't seem safe either. We need to find a way to the other side of the bridge...
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k141; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: A slope leading to the upper level has formed. It seems too steep to climb on foot. Is there some other way up?
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k142; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: We found a motorcycle. We can use it to speed up the slope and keep going.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k143; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: We somehow made it across before the bridge collapsed.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k144; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Helping Each Other in a Crisis
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k146; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Among the people stranded on the bridge's lower level was a man with an injured back.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k147; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: He seems to have hurt his back when the earlier collapse startled him. Is there anything I can do to help?
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k148; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: A woman on the lower level gave me a medicated patch. It should help treat his injury for now.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k149; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: When I gave him the medicated patch, he put it on right away. It seems to be working well. I'm glad I could help.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k150; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: A Couple About to Marry
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k152; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: The two were caught up in this chaos on their way to meet the woman's father. They entrusted me with a game to give him if I meet him.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k154; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: A Model Salesperson?
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k157; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Some of the stranded people are remarkably calm. They're even eager to make sales at a time like this.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k158; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: I was asked to buy some karaage. Apparently, there's a sales quota to meet.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k159; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: A Favor for Risa
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k161; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: After escaping danger on the motorcycle and stopping at the traffic lights on Shirotsumekusa Street, Kashiwagi asked us to follow her somewhere.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k163; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Kashiwagi asked us to follow her somewhere. We decided to go with her as a way of repaying her help.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k164; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: An overpass suddenly collapsed. Beams are coming from above. Has another giant creature appeared? We should hurry to meet up with Kashiwagi and get out of here.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k165; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: This time, a beam caused a tanker truck to explode, sending nearby cars flying. Where is Kashiwagi?
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k166; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Just when we thought we'd made it through using a car transporter, we found ourselves having to pass beneath a golden giant creature's feet.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k167; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: It looks like we've somehow reached our destination. Hopefully, that means our part is done...
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k168; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: An Entrusted Package
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k170; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: We entered a building and were introduced to someone who said they developed software. What's going to happen now?
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k172; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Kashiwagi received a package. For some reason, we're going along with her to the Cosmic Ray Research Institute.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k173; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: When we left the building, we found that a giant creature had destroyed the motorcycle. We decided to head for the station north of here.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k174; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Kashiwagi's injury prevented her from boarding the train. She entrusted us with taking the package to the Cosmic Ray Research Institute.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k175; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
We reached the Cosmic Ray Research Institute. Kashiwagi said we should give the software to its deputy director.
However, something is wrong inside. After various conflicting concerns were raised, I ended up being sent to scout the institute.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k176; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
We don't know which room the deputy director is in, but entering the server
room and restarting the server should let us contact him through the institute's
network. I received a note with the code needed to enter the server room,
but the researcher who gave it to me...
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k177; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
I started the server. After sending a message through the institute's network, I received a reply from someone called Sawada.
I'm to go to the storage room on the second floor.
Apparently, she'll open the door if I knock: 'Knock, knock-knock, knock (pause one beat), knock, knock, BANG!'
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k178; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
The deputy director is in the laboratory.
Chief Researcher Sawada gave me her locker key. I need to borrow the laboratory
keycard from her locker in the room behind the first-floor reception desk.
That should let me enter the laboratory.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k179; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: I delivered the software Kashiwagi entrusted to us to the deputy director. But then a mysterious creature appeared, and the deputy director...
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k180; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Helping an Unlucky Woman
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k182; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: I met a woman beside the station kiosk who was frustrated with her bad luck. Can I do anything to help?
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k184; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: She says she lost one of her earrings. Apparently, she still had it when she arrived at work.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k185; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: It seems she also dropped her wristwatch. She says she had it until she got out of a taxi near the intersection in front of the station...
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k186; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: I managed to find her wristwatch too. Hopefully, her luck will improve now, but what happens next is up to her.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k187; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Escape the Pursuers!
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k189; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: There's no telling what will happen if they catch us. We have to evade them and get out of this tower as quickly as possible!
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k191; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: We somehow got into the elevator and shook off the pursuers. We've escaped them, but...
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k192; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Escape Iberis Tower
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k194; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: A fire has broken out inside the tower. We need to get out of this building as quickly as possible.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k195; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Follow the firefighter's instructions and go down the emergency stairs.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k196; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: A mysterious Labor suddenly appeared, and we ended up in an office somewhere on the 20th floor. We should leave the office and find a route to ground level.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k197; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: A large fire is blocking our path. We need to put it out somehow. Could there be something nearby we can use to extinguish it...?
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k198; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Escape the Harbor Warehouse Area
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k203; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Harbor
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k204; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: We reached the harbor from the rescue boat, but the two pursuers caught up with us and spotted us again.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k205; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: We need to get out of this harbor, quickly. First, let's find somewhere to hide.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k206; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: We ducked into a warehouse, but they came inside too. They have handguns, so we can't afford to be spotted. We need to leave this warehouse without them seeing us.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k207; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
The black Labor that appeared on the ship flew into the air.
We need to get away from this increasingly ominous harbor, quickly...
For now, let's find a way forward.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k209; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: We saw the black Labor from earlier fighting other Labors. Kashiwagi has a motorcycle ready on the other side of their battle. We need to reach her quickly.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k210; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
The warehouse exploded.
We need to get out of this harbor as quickly as possible.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k211; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: We reached Kashiwagi and escaped the harbor on the motorcycle.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k212; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Escape the W&P Office
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k214; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: A Room in the W&P Office
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k215; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: The two pursuers finally caught us. They seem to work for W&P Consulting, a company dealing in weapons intelligence. There's no telling what they'll make us do if we stay captive. We have to escape somehow.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k216; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: First, I need to do something about these restraints. Is there anything I can use to cut the ropes?
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k217; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: I managed to undo the ropes and free myself. I need to untie Yuki quickly so we can escape before the two W&P men spot us.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k218; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Has the battle outside the building ended...? The giant creature is gone, and a huge machine seems to be standing in the city... Let's get out of this building while we can.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k219; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: The huge machine has gone berserk! It's coming toward us! If we don't escape quickly, it'll crush us along with the building...!
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k220; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: We shook off the pursuers and escaped the W&P office.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k221; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: The Pursuers' Organization
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k223; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: In a room at the office they brought us to, they revealed why they'd been chasing us.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k224; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: It seems they intend to use my ability to cause these incidents as a weapon.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k225; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: I obtained a brochure for their organization, W&P Consulting Co., Ltd. It might be worth searching the room for more information.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k226; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: The Way to the Surface
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k228; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Inside the Subway
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k229; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: I met up with Yuki at the park and boarded the subway with her to get away. However, the train suddenly stopped and wouldn't move again. It looks like we'll have to walk to the station and go up to the surface.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k230; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: We decided to head for the station through the dark tunnel.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k231; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Unknown creatures appeared in the darkness, forcing us to take a detour. We need to keep heading for the station.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k232; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: We met a woman named Risa Kashiwagi at the ticket gates. We'll look for a way to the surface with her.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k233; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: We reached the surface! But the creatures from underground came up too...
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k234; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Aboard the Research Vessel
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k236; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: At Sea
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k237; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: When I came to, Yuki and I were somehow floating at sea in a small boat. As we drifted, a research vessel spotted us and brought us aboard.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k238; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: We decided to visit the captain in the observation room to thank him for rescuing us.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k239; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: The captain suggested drying our clothes by the heater. Apparently, it's to the left as we leave the observation room.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k240; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: Yuki and I dried our clothes by the heater. It seems there's still some time before we reach the harbor. Maybe we should explore the ship.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k241; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en: I spoke with the captain. Apparently, he'll retire after this voyage. He gave me his captain's hat.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k242; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
They seem to have lost track of the shadow on the seabed that the scientist was studying.
I'll tell the first mate at the stern to go to the wheelhouse.
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k243; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
The sea suddenly swelled, and a giant monster appeared!
Hurry to the lifeboat!
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0108.json:p0/k244; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
A creature has appeared that would not look out of place in the dinosaur encyclopedias I read as a child.
Perhaps the best description is a sturdy reptile walking on two legs. What appear to be dorsal fins sometimes glow, but many creatures on Earth have luminous body parts. What sets this one apart is its immense size and the beam it fires from its mouth.
That beam's power is extraordinary, leaving the surrounding buildings it struck in a pitiful state.

Could this creature be a descendant of dinosaurs, which were thought to be extinct? Analysis of the footage is underway, and we will report further developments as they arrive.

entries.en: Astonishing! The 'Golden Monster'
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0065.json:p0/k133; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
An enormous golden body, three necks and heads, and wings. What should we call this creature?

It looks like a monster straight out of mythology. Many people would say myths are only myths, but others believe they arose from something real. Would it be too far-fetched to suggest that this creature has existed somewhere on Earth since ancient times and simply remained undiscovered until now?

We humans boast of how far we have advanced, but we must not overlook the fact that new species are still discovered every day.
Human civilization has certainly progressed, but that does not make us all-powerful.

I will never forget how, watching this creature fly away, I felt more awe at its majesty than fear.

entries.en: Concerns over Declining Awareness of Danger
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0065.json:p0/k137; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
There is a word for people who gather to watch trouble: rubberneckers.
Whether it is a fire, a fight, or a crime scene, curiosity overcomes the risk and draws them in.
Yet I saw a young man filming a giant creature on his phone despite the obvious danger to his life. Surely this goes too far.

He is neither a journalist risking his life to report the truth nor someone with a body strong enough to withstand a giant creature.
He clearly lacks awareness of the danger. We do not know whether this young man is among them, but 21 people are believed to have died while similarly absorbed in filming during this latest appearance of giant creatures. All were in their early twenties.

It may be premature to blame it on their youth, but statistics also show awareness of danger declining year after year. This is deeply troubling.

entries.en:
Amid a city where people were desperately trying to flee the mysterious giant creatures, two people on a motorcycle were seen behaving differently from everyone else.
They appeared to be heading in a distinctly different direction.
'Looters' was the word that suddenly came to mind, and I instinctively took a photograph. Sadly, there are plenty of people who brazenly exploit such chaos to commit crimes.
I am not saying that the two in this photograph are among them. Still, having witnessed such scenes many times, I found their behavior impossible to ignore.

Who are these young people, and what are they trying to do? I intend to continue investigating.

entries.en: A Ghost Town? The Surprising Reality
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0065.json:p0/k143; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Not a single person was visible, despite this being the middle of a modern city's office district. It was a veritable ghost town.
But did you notice? This photograph conceals something astonishing.

Even as two giant creatures rampaged through the district, many people were still working.
Look at the photograph. Numerous windows in every building are lit. At first, I assumed everyone had fled without time to turn off the lights, but a closer look revealed moving silhouettes.

An employee of a nearby company, Company A, whom I managed to interview on the spot, told me: 'I know it's dangerous, but hardly any of my bosses or coworkers have gone home...' Is this diligence and loyalty, or a national tendency to follow the crowd? We welcome your thoughts.

entries.en:
The strange beams fired from the three mouths of the enormous golden monster in the office district were the same golden color as its body.
Many witnesses said that, despite their gruesome destructive power, the brilliant golden light seemed almost divine.
Since ancient times, humanity has revered gold and its color. Is this because they symbolize the sun?
In modern times, gold also represents wealth. In fact, images spreading online have reportedly led more people to use photographs of those beams as phone wallpapers to bring financial good fortune. Should we call this obliviousness to danger, or applaud their resilience?

entries.en: Deep Scars Left Behind
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0065.json:p0/k151; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
Collapsed buildings and destroyed roads were found throughout the area where the two dinosaur-like giant creatures appeared.
This photograph shows one such intersection. The junction of major roads has been gouged out, with the surrounding asphalt peeled upward into walls.
Naturally, the utility lines beneath it were also severed. Restoring them is expected to require not only time but enormous expense.
The nearby offices are unusable as well, inflicting severe losses on their companies.
Some companies are seeking temporary offices, but many cannot even manage that and have no choice but to file for bankruptcy.
The scars left by these giant creatures run deeper and wider than this photograph can show.

entries.en: A Display of Skill
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0065.json:p0/k153; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
When a beam from the golden creature blew up a tanker truck, I managed to photograph an extraordinary sight.
The white car hanging in the air was hurled upward by the blast. Can you see the motorcycle lying sideways beneath it?
It had not crashed. It was sliding on its side to pass beneath the flying car.
I had seen this in films, but never expected to witness it before my own eyes.
After dodging the car, the rider expertly brought the motorcycle upright and slipped past the burning tanker as though nothing had happened.
The rider appeared to be young. Was this young person a professional driver, or was it a miracle born of an emergency?
Either way, it was a moment that proved this could be done without camera tricks or computer graphics.

entries.en: A Mysterious Conviction? Riding Beneath a Monster's Feet
entries.notes: English draft imported from audited private workspace, translate-en-0065.json:p0/k155; human editorial and runtime review pending.

entries.en:
I photographed two motorcycles speeding beneath a giant creature whose single foot was large enough to block two or three lanes.
Were their riders carrying out some important mission? Or were they simply not thinking?
The thought that they might have a death wish crossed my mind, but the young people seemed to slip expertly past the monster's feet.
These motorcycles have been identified as the ones seen behaving suspiciously at several other locations.
Perhaps these young people are not human, but human-looking creatures controlling the giant beings.
And perhaps following them will reveal the mystery behind the giant creatures' appearances, and even the key to driving them away.
I will continue investigating. Please await further reports.
